description: Direct WebFetch of https://www.nbrm.mk/podzakonski-akti-koisto-proizleguvaat-od-zakonot-za-platezni-uslugi-i-platni-sistemi.nspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: Could not retrieve the bylaw index page contents; page is indexed by search engines and linked, so the 403 is most consistent with bot defence, not a dead page. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: The whole nbrm.mk domain may need a browser-grade fetcher (real UA, JS, cookies) for the collection pipeline; a naive HTTP crawler would wrongly mark the regulator's core pages dead.

description: No dedicated NBRM public-consultation section (e.g. 'јавна консултација' / 'предлог-одлука за коментари') was located during this pass.

result.result_summary: Searches combining 'Народна банка' with 'јавна консултација' and 'предлог одлука' returned ministry/ENER material and media items, not an NBRM consultation hub.

why_it_matters: A3 tracks consultations; if NBRM genuinely publishes draft bylaws only via ENER or ad-hoc press releases, the collection design must rely on those proxies rather than a regulator consultation feed.

description: No machine-readable feed (RSS/Atom, open-data API, or structured regulation dataset) for NBRM regulatory acts was identified.

result.result_summary: Only HTML .nspx pages and PDF documents under /content/Regulativa/ were observed.

why_it_matters: Collection will have to be HTML-diff based, raising fragility and the need for snapshot hashing of consolidated PDFs.

description: The Macedonian/Bulgarian term overlap for 'платежни услуги и платни системи' and 'регистар' pulls Bulgarian National Bank (bnb.bg) pages into MK-language result sets repeatedly.

result.result_summary: Several queries returned bnb.bg registry pages as top hits despite MK-specific phrasing.

why_it_matters: Automated query pipelines for MK must domain-restrict or add 'Северна Македонија'/'РСМ' disambiguators, or they will silently ingest Bulgarian regulation as Macedonian.

description: The Official Gazette full archive is subscription-based (members.slvesnik.com.mk, euslugi.slvesnik.com.mk online payment).

result.result_summary: A free-access section exists but full authoritative issue PDFs sit behind subscription/login.

why_it_matters: Pinning exact entry-into-force dates from the legally authoritative text may require a paid subscription; otherwise A3 must rely on NBRM's own consolidated texts and citations.

description: No dedicated NBRM public-consultation portal was found. Searches in Macedonian for 'јавна консултација', 'консултативен документ', 'нацрт-одлука ставена на увид на јавноста', 'забелешки и предлози', and in English for 'public consultation' / 'draft decision' / 'comments deadline' on nbrm.mk returned only final adopted decisions, consolidated texts and press releases — never a consultation landing page, a draft open for comment, or a feedback statement.

result.result_summary: NBRM appears not to operate an ECB/EBA-style consultation hub with published comment windows and published responses. Consultation appears to run through the banking association and working groups, and, for primary legislation, through ENER (Ministry of Finance as proposer).

why_it_matters: The cell's core premise — that consultation drafts are the earliest legally-visible signal — holds for LAWS (via ENER) but only weakly for NBRM BYLAWS. For bylaws the earliest reliable public signal is the annual Work Programme plus the post-Council-session announcement, which arrives at adoption, not before. Collection design must lean on ENER + Work Programme + MBA rather than on a nonexistent NBRM consultation feed.

description: www.nbrm.mk returns HTTP 403 Forbidden to WebFetch and to curl with a realistic desktop Chrome User-Agent, on both the homepage and deep pages (e.g. /regulativa.nspx, /rieghulativa_za_platnitie_sistiemi.nspx).

result.result_summary: 0 of 2 curl probes and 1 of 1 WebFetch probe succeeded; response bodies ~5.6-5.8 KB, consistent with a WAF challenge page rather than a real 404.

why_it_matters: The single most important source family in this cell is not collectible with plain HTTP. This is a HYPOTHESIS of bot protection, not evidence the site is dead — the same URLs are indexed and returned by search engines. Any collector for MK/A3 must budget for a headless browser or an authorised feed.

description: finance.gov.mk and vlada.mk both timed out after 25 seconds from this environment; ener.gov.mk root returned 200 but the guessed listing path Default.aspx?item=pub_regulation returned 404.

result.result_summary: Ministry of Finance and Government hosts unverified; ENER root live but its listing route must be discovered from the rendered UI rather than guessed.

why_it_matters: Do not record these as dead. The ENER item-detail route (Default.aspx?item=pub_regulation&subitem=view_reg_detail&itemid=NNNNN) is confirmed from indexed URLs, so the listing route exists under a different parameter set and needs one browser session to capture.

description: No Macedonian-language hits were found for a regulator-published 'impact assessment' of an NBRM bylaw. ПВР (Проценка на влијанието на регулативата) is a Government/ministry instrument tied to ENER and draft LAWS; nothing indicates NBRM publishes RIA documents for its own decisions.

result.result_summary: Impact assessments in MK are a ministry obligation, not a central-bank one.

why_it_matters: The 'impact assessments' element of this coverage cell should be re-scoped to ENER/ministry ПВР reports on financial-sector bills, and the run should not expect NBRM-authored impact assessments.

description: Acronym drift is a real collection hazard: the institution is НБРМ (Народна банка на Република Македонија) pre-2019 and НБРСМ / 'Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија' after, while the domain and much English content still say NBRM. Older PDFs are headed 'НАРОДНА БАНКА НА РЕПУБЛИКА МАКЕДОНИЈА'.

result.result_summary: Queries using only one variant miss material; 'НБРСМ' in particular returned poorer results than the spelled-out modern name.

why_it_matters: Any keyword-based collector or alerting rule must carry all of: НБРМ, НБРСМ, Народна банка, National Bank of the Republic of North Macedonia, National Bank of North Macedonia, NBRNM.

description: 'консултација' in Macedonian search is dominated by IMF Article IV consultations and by World-Bank/PEFA environmental-and-social 'јавна консултација' notices, and 'предлог' matches every government bill in the country.

result.result_summary: Both seed-query terms are low-precision on their own.

why_it_matters: Queries must be anchored with an institution token ('Народна банка', site:nbrm.mk) or a domain token ('платежни услуги', 'супервизија') to be usable in an automated discovery loop.

description: No evidence surfaced of a recent (post-2008) full IMF/World Bank FSAP or FSSA for North Macedonia. Search results referenced the 2003 FSAP and the 2008 FSAP Update with Basel Core Principles and stress-testing technical notes, but no newer cycle.

result.result_summary: Only historic FSAP material located; no announcement of a scheduled new MK FSAP found in this pass.

why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed FSAP material as a pillar; if the latest assessment is ~2008, Article IV staff reports and the EC enlargement report carry more current supervisory assessment weight.

description: No dedicated North Macedonia module was found for global regulatory-tracker vendors (Thomson Reuters Regulatory Intelligence, Wolters Kluwer, Corlytics, CUBE) in open search; such coverage, if it exists, sits entirely behind sales walls.

result.result_summary: Vendor trackers could not be confirmed to cover MK at country granularity.

why_it_matters: Means the commercial-tracker leg of this cell is unverified and may need direct vendor enquiry rather than open-web monitoring.

description: Attempts to locate a Moody's-published North Macedonia banking-sector outlook returned nothing specific; only Fitch sovereign material surfaced for MK.

result.result_summary: Fitch confirmed as an active MK sovereign rater; Moody's MK banking coverage not evidenced.

why_it_matters: Avoids assuming a second rating-agency data stream that may not exist for this market.

description: The Macedonian-language search performed (mandatory local-language pass) returned overwhelmingly national primary sources — NBRNM law pages, Ministry of Finance portal PDFs, commercial-bank customer notices, Chamber of Commerce draft-law files — rather than English cross-border aggregators. No MK-language law-firm legal-bulletin service was identified in this pass.

result.result_summary: Local-language query surfaced primary/national sources belonging to other coverage cells, plus one useful government mirror of Fitch reports.

why_it_matters: Confirms this cell is genuinely English-dominant, but also that MK-language law-firm newsletters are an unmapped gap; the mchamber.mk draft-law PDF hints at a consultation-tracking route worth handing to the national-sources cell.

description: Several high-value monitors are paywalled or registration-gated: SeeNews, bne IntelliNews, Central Banking, Mondaq, Lexology and Fitch's own portal.

result.result_summary: Headline-level monitoring is feasible; full-text collection requires subscriptions.

why_it_matters: Budget and ToS constraints shape what can be automated versus what must be manual or licensed.

description: Direct WebFetch of the ESJN public-access homepage (https://e-nabavki.gov.mk/PublicAccess/home.aspx) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.

result.result_summary: No page content retrieved. Multiple independent official pages (finance.gov.mk, vlada.mk, bjn.gov.mk) reference the portal as the live, mandatory national system, so this is treated as bot-defence, not a dead source. Status: unverified, hypothesis = live but bot-defended.

why_it_matters: The single most important source in this cell will need a browser-grade fetcher (real UA, cookies, possibly ViewState handling) or the documented .asmx/service endpoints rather than a naive HTTP client.

description: No dedicated public 'јавни набавки' landing page for the National Bank (NBRSM) was located in this pass.

result.result_summary: Local-language searches combining Народна банка + јавни набавки returned only institutional pages (за НБРСМ, конкурси, контакт) and the text of the Public Procurement Law hosted on nbrm.mk — not a procurement notice list.

why_it_matters: Central-bank payment-system tenders are the highest-value signal in this cell; if NBRSM has no own-site listing, collection must go through ESJN filtered by contracting authority, which makes the ESJN collector a single point of failure.

description: No specific live or recent MK tender for ATM/POS/card/core-banking systems was surfaced by search in this pass.

result.result_summary: Local-language queries on банкомати / ПОС терминали / платен систем + тендер returned the ESJN portal, the Public Procurement Law and unrelated commercial POS pages, but no concrete notice. This reflects search-engine coverage of the ASP.NET portal, not absence of such tenders.

why_it_matters: Confirms that keyword discovery via general web search is not viable for this cell — the collector must query ESJN/TED directly by CPV code and contracting authority, not rely on search engines.

description: Numerous commercial tender aggregators (tenderinfo.org, tenderdetail.com, globaltenders.com, tenderimpulse.com, tendersontime.com, gtbc.net, developmentaid.org) claim North Macedonia coverage.

result.result_summary: These were seen in results but not adopted as candidates: they are paywalled, of unverified completeness, republish official data, and their terms typically forbid systematic reuse.

why_it_matters: Tempting shortcuts that would introduce licensing risk and unverifiable provenance into a source register whose value depends on primary-source traceability. DevelopmentAid is the least objectionable for IFI forecast notices but still paywalled.

description: Службен весник на РСМ (Official Gazette) as a secondary publication channel for procurement notices was noted but not directly assessed.

result.result_summary: The Public Procurement Law text indicates notices may be published in ЕСЈН and/or the Official Gazette, with above-threshold notices also in the EU Official Journal. The Gazette's own portal was not fetched in this pass.

why_it_matters: The Gazette is the authoritative legal record and the place where the regulatory obligation behind a tender is actually promulgated; it should be scouted as a companion source in a later pass.

description: No AML/sanctions-screening vendor announcement naming a specific North Macedonian bank was found, in either English or Macedonian, despite AML being an explicit EU-accession compliance driver.

result.result_summary: Searches returned only generic global AML-vendor listicles, a MONEYVAL 2025 review summary, and the MBA AML commission page — no vendor press release or case study naming an MK bank customer.

why_it_matters: AML screening is one of the mandates most likely to be procured under NDA; if vendors never publish MK references, the pointer strategy for this specific mandate fails and coverage must shift to conference speaker lists, job ads and regulator enforcement notices.

description: No private-sector tender aggregator carrying MK bank RFPs was located.

result.result_summary: Macedonian-language tender searches returned only the state e-Nabavki (ESJN) portal, the Public Procurement Law, ministry pages and the EU TED platform. No commercial MK aggregator publishing private-company RFPs surfaced.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell rationale: private MK bank buying leaves no tender trace at all, so vendor announcements and trade press are the only route — a structural, not a search-depth, limitation.

description: No North Macedonia customer reference was found for the major global core-banking and ATM vendors (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finastra, Diebold Nixdorf, NCR Atleos).

result.result_summary: Targeted English search returned only Wikipedia bank profiles; no vendor page, case study or press release tied any of these vendors to an MK bank.

why_it_matters: Suggests MK core-banking estates are either legacy in-house, served by regional players (ASEE) rather than tier-1 global vendors, or covered by confidentiality — an important shaping assumption for the whole workstream that should be tested directly on each vendor's site rather than via search engines.

description: Macedonian-language vendor-marketing vocabulary is thin: most MK IT suppliers publish case studies in English only, and Albanian-language coverage was not attempted in this cell.

result.result_summary: MK queries surfaced news media and regulators far more readily than vendor case studies; the productive MK terms were journalistic ('лансираше', 'имплементираше', 'соработка') rather than procurement terms.

why_it_matters: Collection rules should search MK for trade press and EN for vendor sites, and a follow-up run should add Albanian (sq) terms given the Albanian-language segment of the MK market.

description: Two candidate URLs were inferred from vendor branding rather than confirmed by a fetch.

result.result_summary: nextsense.com and payten.com/en/news-events/ were not directly fetched in this run; the underlying companies are confirmed to exist and be active in/around MK, but the exact canonical paths must be checked by the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Prevents a broken entry point being treated as a live source.

description: English-language search for current compliance/AML vacancies at Skopje banks ('compliance officer AML job Skopje bank vacancy 2026') returned essentially no MK-specific results — hits were South African, Indian, UK and Kosovo boards.

result.result_summary: Generic international job aggregators dominate; no MK bank vacancy surfaced in English.

why_it_matters: Confirms that hiring-signal collection for MK MUST run on Macedonian-language terms and on local boards; an English-only pipeline for this cell would be near-blind.

description: No dedicated events/seminars calendar page was located on mba.mk (Macedonian Banking Association) during this run; only news and tag pages surfaced.

result.result_summary: Association seminar agendas — the highest-value artefact for this cell — could not be confirmed as published on a public page.

why_it_matters: MBA training may be members-only or communicated by e-mail, meaning the strongest early-warning artefact may not be publicly collectable and would need a proxy (ABIT, Chamber, press coverage).

description: Finelevate Digital Summit 2026 (Skopje, 16 Sept 2026) and MicroBalkans 2026 are described in MK press, but their official event domains were not identified in this run; EACHA's official domain is inferred from the organisation name only.

result.result_summary: Three high-value agenda sources exist as press descriptions without a confirmed canonical URL.

why_it_matters: Agendas and speaker lists are the payload; without the canonical site the run can only harvest second-hand summaries. Domain resolution should be a follow-up task, not an invented URL.

description: LinkedIn job search and company employee data are behind a login wall and prohibited by ToS for automated collection.

result.result_summary: The richest structured hiring-signal source cannot be legally scraped.

why_it_matters: Any hiring-trend quantification must rely on MK job boards plus manual LinkedIn review, which limits statistical claims about posting volume.

description: No Macedonian chapter or MK-localised certification body for ACAMS/ICA-style AML certification, and no MK certification announcements register, was found with the queries run.

result.result_summary: Certification signal for MK appears to run through international bodies and individual employer press releases rather than a national registry.

why_it_matters: Certification-announcement tracking for MK will have to be person-level (press releases, LinkedIn) rather than registry-level, which is weaker and slower.

description: No Albanian-language (sq) search was run, although Albanian is a widely used official language in North Macedonia and some institutions publish vacancies in it.

result.result_summary: sq-language hiring and training ads were not covered; the run scope named mk and en only.

why_it_matters: A share of PSP/bank branch and training announcements in western MK may be missed entirely.

description: Searched in mk and en for a dedicated financial-services ombudsman / out-of-court dispute-resolution body for banking and payments in North Macedonia. Nothing of that kind surfaced; the ОПМ description of the grievance path routes financial complaints to NBRM (banks/savings houses), Ministry of Finance (financial companies), the Insurance Supervision Agency, and the State Market Inspectorate.

result.result_summary: No sector-specific financial ombudsman identified; grievance handling appears split across the sectoral supervisors plus the general Народен правобранител.

why_it_matters: Means there is no single ADR docket to monitor; complaint intelligence must be assembled from NBRM's aggregate complaints report, the general Ombudsman, and the courts.

description: Attempts to reach a keyword-searchable database of Управен суд / Виш управен суд judgments on banking or payment fees returned only WebSphere portal landing pages with opaque /wps/portal/ !ut/p/ URLs and no visible full-text search over judgments.

result.result_summary: Administrative court case law appears not to be exposed as a queryable, enumerable corpus on the open web.

why_it_matters: The cell's highest-value signal — rulings that name the specific provision under stress — may only be reachable by browser navigation, by Freedom-of-Information request, or indirectly via legal media such as Правдико.

description: An English search result titled 'Court Blocks Bank Fees, Empowers Consumers' on athens-times.com surfaced. It was not fetched or corroborated, and its relationship to North Macedonia (as opposed to Greece or another jurisdiction) is unestablished.

result.result_summary: Recorded as an unverified lead only; deliberately NOT entered as a candidate source.

why_it_matters: Aggregator headlines about court rulings on bank fees are exactly the kind of item that gets miscountried; it needs verification against a primary court source before use.

description: www.nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a direct fetch of the consumer-information page. The site is indexed and returns rich search results, so this is a bot-defence hypothesis, not evidence the resource is unavailable.

result.result_summary: NBRM pages recorded as blocked=true with blocker_type http_403_bot_defence; liveness left to the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Collection design for the highest-priority source in this cell must budget for a headless-browser or authenticated-UA fetch path.

description: Run scope specified languages mk and en only. No searches were run in Albanian (sq), despite North Macedonia having a substantial Albanian-speaking population and institutions publishing bilingually (e.g. the State Audit Office masthead includes 'Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit').

result.result_summary: Albanian-language grievance and consumer-organisation channels are unexplored in this slice.

why_it_matters: Regional consumer organisations (Tetovo, Kičevo) and their complaint output may publish primarily in Albanian and would be missed entirely.

description: Searched in both Macedonian and English for an RSS/Atom feed or e-mail alert subscription on nbrm.mk (соопштенија, вести, претплата, е-пошта; 'RSS feed announcements National Bank North Macedonia decisions'). No feed URL surfaced in results and the site could not be crawled directly for <link rel=alternate> tags because of a 403.

result.result_summary: No confirmed RSS/Atom or mailing-list endpoint for NBRM announcements. Unresolved, not disproven — the .nspx CMS may still expose one at an unadvertised path.

why_it_matters: Without a push feed, A3 monitoring of the single most important MK regulator must fall back to polling + archive diffing, which is more fragile and more likely to miss a short consultation deadline.

description: https://www.nbrm.mk/statistika-en.nspx returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to the agent's fetcher while the domain is well indexed and serves content to browsers.

result.result_summary: nbrm.mk is bot-defended, not dead. HYPOTHESIS: WAF or user-agent filtering.

why_it_matters: The whole nbrm.mk document estate — the core of this cell — may need browser-context or UA-spoofed collection; a naive verifier could wrongly mark dozens of critical URLs as dead.

description: https://data.gov.mk/ returned connect ECONNREFUSED 95.180.140.102:443 on a single attempt.

result.result_summary: National open data portal unreachable in this run; API family (CKAN vs DKAN vs custom) therefore unconfirmed.

why_it_matters: The portal's API shape determines whether financial-sector datasets can be harvested cheaply; this must be re-probed before the collection method for that source is fixed.

description: web.archive.org is not fetchable from this agent's WebFetch tool ('Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org'), so no CDX result set could be enumerated for nbrm.mk or slvesnik.com.mk.

result.result_summary: Actual archive coverage depth for MK regulator domains is UNMEASURED in this run.

why_it_matters: The central premise of this cell — that archives preserve the version history of silently-replaced regulator pages — is unverified for these specific domains; a JS-heavy .nspx CMS may be poorly captured, in which case the run needs its own snapshotting rather than relying on Wayback.

description: The statutory Register of Payment Institutions kept by the National Bank (Регистар на платежни институции, a public book in electronic form under the Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи) was confirmed to exist in law, but Macedonian-language searching surfaced Bulgarian BNB registers instead and did not return the MK register's own landing URL.

result.result_summary: Register existence confirmed from statute; canonical URL not found.

why_it_matters: For payments-sector A3 this register is a top-tier entity feed; leaving its URL unknown is a concrete, closable gap.

description: The Macedonian query for payment-service-provider registers was dominated by Bulgarian National Bank pages (BNB uses near-identical Cyrillic terminology: 'регистър на доставчици на платежни услуги' vs MK 'регистар на даватели на платежни услуги').

result.result_summary: Cross-language Cyrillic contamination between BG and MK financial terminology is a systematic noise source.

why_it_matters: Any automated MK query must be domain-pinned (site:.mk / site:nbrm.mk) or it will silently harvest Bulgarian regulation and mislabel it as MK — a correctness risk for A3 conclusions.

description: Службен весник offers a free-issue tier, but structured search, consolidated texts and the full back-catalogue are positioned as a subscription product of the publishing public enterprise.

result.result_summary: Free PDF issue access appears available; systematic search over the gazette likely requires a paid subscription.

why_it_matters: Determines whether gazette monitoring can be fully automated at zero cost or needs a licence line-item; also affects legal reuse posture.

description: Searched in both mk and en for a structured, machine-readable bill-tracking portal for the Assembly of RNM (an 'e-Sobranie' / e-democracy legislative tracker with per-bill status, sponsor and stage). Local-language queries around 'предлог закони во собраниска процедура' and English queries around 'e-demokratija / eSobranie / legislation tracker' returned only the general sobranie.mk .nspx pages and third-party guides.

result.result_summary: No dedicated open bill-tracker or API was found. Bill tracking appears to require scraping sobranie.mk session/committee pages (sessiondetails.nspx) and joining them to ЕНЕР and vlada.mk session readouts.

why_it_matters: Bill-stage tracking for banking and payments statutes will need a bespoke, brittle scraper across three sites rather than one feed, raising build cost and the risk of missing a fast-tracked amendment (скратена/итна постапка).

description: No RSS/Atom feed, bulk download or API was identified for Службен весник issues, in either language. The publisher site itself could not be fetched (TLS chain error) so the presence of a free structured index remains unverified.

result.result_summary: Gazette monitoring must be assumed to be HTML/PDF scraping of the issue index, or purchase of the publisher's subscription database.

why_it_matters: The gazette is the legally binding trigger for every deadline in this cell; without a feed, latency and completeness depend entirely on our own polling cadence.

description: Searched in mk for a separate 'Закон за електронски пари' / 'издавачи на електронски пари'. Results consistently point instead to e-money being regulated inside the Закон за платежни услуги и платни системи (Сл. весник 90 од 12.4.2022, in application from 1.1.2023), which transposes PSD2 and the e-money directives.

result.result_summary: No standalone e-money act found; e-money institutions (институции за електронски пари) are authorised under the payment services law.

why_it_matters: Prevents a false coverage gap: monitoring should key on the payment-services statute and its amendments rather than hunting a non-existent e-money act.

description: Four target pages resisted automated fetching in this pass: slvesnik.com.mk (TLS 'unable to verify the first certificate'), sobranie.mk (HTTP 403 on the root), guides.loc.gov (HTTP 403), and an ENER deep link Default.aspx?...itemid=77045 (HTTP 404 despite being indexed with a title).

result.result_summary: All four are recorded as unverified/blocked hypotheses, not dead. The 403s look like bot defence; the TLS error looks like an incomplete intermediate chain; the ENER 404 looks like a state-dependent ASP.NET deep link.

why_it_matters: The collection layer for this cell must use a browser-grade fetcher (real user-agent, relaxed-but-logged TLS handling, session cookies) rather than a plain HTTP client, or the highest-value sources will look unreachable.

description: Third-party monitoring (Огледало на Владата / MCIC / CRC) reports that only about 51% of draft laws adopted by the Government and sent to Parliament in 2023 were published on ЕНЕР, and that ministries answered roughly 20% of submitted comments.

result.result_summary: ЕНЕР cannot be treated as a complete census of forthcoming statutes.

why_it_matters: Roughly half of banking/payments/AML bills may reach Parliament with no prior consultation footprint, so vlada.mk session readouts and Собрание agendas must be monitored independently rather than as confirmation of an ЕНЕР hit.

description: Searched in Macedonian for a UJP-published register/list of approved fiscal device types and manufacturers ('одобрени фискални апарати список производители одобрение'). Results were dominated by Bulgarian registers (НАП/БИМ) and returned no MK list.

result.result_summary: No MK approved-fiscal-device register located in this pass; however the UJP regulation register does contain a 'Правилник за регистарот на одобрени фискални системи' (effective 08.04.2016), so a register almost certainly exists somewhere on ujp.gov.mk or in the Gazette.

why_it_matters: The approved-device register is the single most commercially relevant list for POS/fiscal hardware vendors; missing it leaves a hole in competitor and certification tracking.

description: Cyrillic queries about fiscal devices retrieved predominantly Bulgarian-language results because 'фискални устройства/апарати' terminology is shared across bg and mk.

result.result_summary: Query needs MK-disambiguating tokens ('Северна Македонија', 'УЈП', 'фискална апаратура', 'готовински плаќања') or a site: filter on ujp.gov.mk.

why_it_matters: Without disambiguation, automated MK collection will ingest Bulgarian regulatory content and produce false compliance signals.

description: No dedicated public-consultation ('јавна расправа' / 'предлог акти') landing page was located on ufr.gov.mk, azlp.mk or kzk.gov.mk within this pass; ASO was the only cell authority whose regulation section was described as including public-consultation acts.

result.result_summary: Consultation signals for UFR/AZLP/KZK likely surface only via ENER or the Gazette rather than on the authorities' own sites.

why_it_matters: Consultations is a named topic for this run; if the authorities do not publish drafts themselves, ENER becomes a single point of failure for early warning.

description: Searched mk for AZLP decisions concerning banks. Found training/news items and general guidance, but no searchable database of AZLP supervisory decisions or fines.

result.result_summary: AZLP appears to publish news and guidance rather than a structured decision register; individual decisions may only be discoverable via news items or FOI.

why_it_matters: Without a decision register, enforcement-trend analysis for data protection in banking must rely on news scraping, which is lossy.

description: The data protection authority appears under two names: the historical 'Дирекција за заштита на личните податоци' (Directorate) and the current 'Агенција за заштита на личните податоци' (АЗЛП).

result.result_summary: Both names must be in the glossary; older documents and third-party references use 'Дирекција'.

why_it_matters: Name-based monitoring keyed only to 'Агенција' will miss the pre-rename corpus and citations.

description: No public, structured EU- or MK-side tracker was found that maps individual EU financial-services acts (PSD2, CRR/CRD, Solvency II, MiFID II, DGSD, IFR) to their MK transposing act with dates. The information exists but is scattered across the NPAA, screening report and per-law conformity statements.

result.result_summary: Searches for a transposition tracker returned only narrative documents, not a machine-readable correspondence table.

why_it_matters: Any deadline register for MK financial regulation must be assembled by parsing the NPAA and Sobranie conformity statements; no ready-made feed exists to subscribe to.

description: The Macedonian-language query on the EC report and Chapter 9 returned the reports themselves but no MK-language page devoted specifically to Chapter 9 / financial services within the negotiating structure (working group composition, chapter negotiating position).

result.result_summary: Local-language results were dominated by general NPAA and country-report pages; the Chapter 9 working group was not surfaced.

why_it_matters: The chapter working group and its negotiating position would be the highest-value MK-side document for regulatory deadlines; its absence from search may mean it is unpublished or buried behind mep.gov.mk site navigation.

description: The TAIEX database itself was not fetched; the July 2026 NBRM independence mission was learned about only via secondary local media reporting.

result.result_summary: Public listing of TAIEX missions for MK financial institutions could not be confirmed in this pass.

why_it_matters: If TAIEX listings are gated, MK-side institutional newsrooms and local media become the only practical detector of these missions.

description: The ASO fintech-strategy PDF URL was taken from a search result and its filename appears garbled in transcription; it has not been fetched.

result.result_summary: Document confirmed to exist ('Финтек-стратегија за финансиски регулатори, 2023-2027', hosted on aso.mk) but exact path is unverified.

why_it_matters: Downstream verification must resolve the path from aso.mk rather than trusting the recorded URL.

description: No evidence of a national/domestic card scheme (a Macedonian-branded card scheme with its own scheme rulebook) was found. Searches in Macedonian for 'национална картична шема / домашна картична схема' returned nothing; CaSys appears as a processor and card-system operator for international schemes (Visa/Mastercard) rather than a domestic brand owner.

result.result_summary: Cell hypothesis of a 'national card scheme' is unsupported by evidence found in this pass.

why_it_matters: Avoids building a monitoring stream for an actor that may not exist; redirects effort to CaSys and the international scheme rulebooks as the real card rule-setters.

description: No publicly posted KIBS participation criteria / admission rulebook page or tariff schedule was located as a distinct, navigable page; only a single 'PravilaZaRabota.pdf' surfaced via the search index, and no tariff (тарифник) document was found.

result.result_summary: KIBS document tree is not exposed via an obvious public 'Documents' section.

why_it_matters: Participation criteria and pricing are core cell content; if they are participant-only, collection must rely on regulator filings and bank T&C restatements instead.

description: No dedicated public-consultation portal for draft NBRSM decisions on payment systems (предлог одлуки / јавна расправа with comment submission) was identified; only finalised 'Одлуки' and 'Подзаконски акти' index pages were found.

result.result_summary: Consultations topic is weakly covered for this cell.

why_it_matters: Consultations are one of the run's four topics; if drafts are not published, early-warning must come from the National Payment System Council and the banking association instead.

description: A direct WebFetch of https://www.nbrm.mk/makiedonska_platiezhna_infrastruktura.nspx returned HTTP 403. This is treated as a hypothesis of bot defence, not as evidence the page is dead — the same site's URLs appear healthy in the search index.

result.result_summary: nbrm.mk requires browser-like fetching.

why_it_matters: The entire regulator/operator backbone of this cell lives on nbrm.mk; the collector must use a browser-grade fetcher or it will record false negatives across the board.

description: The CaSys corporate domain (casys.com.mk) was inferred rather than confirmed; only third-party listings (LinkedIn, MASIT member directory) were observed directly in results.

result.result_summary: CaSys primary web presence needs resolution before collection.

why_it_matters: CaSys is the domestic card rule-setter for this cell; an unresolved primary domain leaves a hole in card-side rule monitoring.

description: www.nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain WebFetch of the PI/EMI/PSO hub page.

result.result_summary: No page content retrieved; register contents could not be read directly in this pass.

why_it_matters: The single most important domain in this cell is bot-defended, so the pipeline must use a browser-grade fetcher. This is a hypothesis about bot defence, not evidence the page is dead.

description: finance.gov.mk registers page failed with ECONNREFUSED on port 443.

result.result_summary: Ministry of Finance register hub could not be enumerated; sub-register URLs for financial companies remain unknown.

why_it_matters: The MoF-supervised financial-company perimeter is a real gap in the register map; needs a retry from a different egress before any conclusion.

description: No search result surfaced a confirmed official domain for Фонд за осигурување на депозити; the URL recorded is an inference and the seed term 'fosigurad.mk' returned nothing authoritative.

result.result_summary: Deposit Insurance Fund membership list located conceptually but not by verified URL.

why_it_matters: Membership list is a valuable independent cross-check on the bank/savings-house licence register; the correct domain must be resolved before collection.

description: A dedicated landing URL for the 'Регистар на платежни институции' (as distinct from the e-money register and the payment-system-operator register) was not surfaced by either MK or EN queries.

result.result_summary: Only the hub page and the EMI/PSO register pages were located by URL.

why_it_matters: The payment-institution register is the core artefact of this cell; its exact URL must be recovered by crawling the hub page with a browser-grade fetcher.

description: No evidence was found of an open-data/API or CSV endpoint for any NBRNM supervised-entity register; everything observed is HTML pages plus occasional XLS/PDF attachments.

result.result_summary: Collection will require HTML/attachment parsing rather than API ingestion.

why_it_matters: Determines collector design and diffing strategy; also means register history is likely not archived by the regulator.

description: For Halkbank AD Skopje no dedicated announcements/notices index page was surfaced by MK-language search; only tariff and documents/forms pages were found.

result.result_summary: Searched 'halkbank.mk соопштенија известување измена на општи услови применува од' — results returned product and document pages only. Not verified as absent; the site may host notices behind an unindexed .nspx path or inside PDFs.

why_it_matters: One of the larger banks in the cell may need PDF-diff monitoring of tariff/terms documents rather than a notice feed.

description: Fetch of https://www.unibank.com.mk/ returned no output; the working UNIBanka domain observed in search results is unibank.mk.

result.result_summary: Treated as a hypothesis, not a verdict — unibank.com.mk may be bot-defended, parked, or a redirect. Candidate recorded against unibank.mk.

why_it_matters: Domain ambiguity would break automated collection for this issuer if the wrong host is configured.

description: Fetch of the Sparkasse Bank homepage returned navigation without resolvable URLs for news, notices, tariffs or reports; the announcements path was recovered only via site-scoped search.

result.result_summary: Homepage rendering is JS-dependent; the dated /mk/soopshtenija/ path was confirmed indirectly through search results.

why_it_matters: Collector must seed the announcements path directly rather than crawl from the homepage.

description: https://www.mse.mk/mk/issuers/all returned HTTP 404; no complete listed-issuer index URL was confirmed.

result.result_summary: Individual issuer slugs were confirmed (komercijalna-banka-ad-skopje, unibanka-ad-skopje, centralna-kooperativna-banka-ad-skopje) but the enumeration endpoint was not.

why_it_matters: Without the index, the bank issuer universe must be seeded manually or derived from the supervisor's licensed-bank list.

description: No cross-bank aggregator of customer notices / general-terms amendments with effective dates was found for MK in either language.

result.result_summary: Searches in mk and en returned only per-bank pages plus trade press; no consumer-protection or association-run consolidated register surfaced.

why_it_matters: Bank-level effective-date tracking must be built as N per-bank collectors; there is no single upstream feed to lean on.

description: English-language searching surfaced almost nothing cell-specific: EN queries mostly returned Wikipedia entity pages, not bank notices or filings.

result.result_summary: Practically all usable artefacts (соопштенија, известувања, тарифник, Извештај и податоци за Банката, СЕИ-Нет filings) exist only in Macedonian.

why_it_matters: An English-only collector for this cell would be near-empty; MK keyword sets are mandatory.

description: No dedicated fintech/payments trade association exists as an overarching body in North Macedonia. A comparative legal guide states there is no overarching trade association for the fintech sector; the closest organised bodies are the Association of Financial Companies (AFD/AFSANM, alternative lending) and the Chamber's Grouping of Non-Bank Financial Companies.

result.result_summary: Searched in both mk and en for a payments/fintech association; only non-bank-lending and ICT bodies surfaced.

why_it_matters: Payment institutions and e-money institutions have no single collective voice, so their reactions to draft payment rules must be tracked institution-by-institution or via MBA/MASIT/AFD proxies.

description: No dedicated, indexed 'position papers' or 'коментари на нацрт закони' section was located on mba.mk. The site's visible structure is За нас / Активности / SKIBOR / Финансиска едукација / Фондација; positions appear to be embedded in news items (соопштенија) rather than a document library.

result.result_summary: Fetched mba.mk members page and reviewed site sections; no consultations/position archive observed.

why_it_matters: Collection must be full-text over the news stream rather than a targeted document feed, and older positions may be unrecoverable.

description: Canonical homepages for two chambers were not directly confirmed: Стопанска комора на северо-западна Македонија (inferred oemvp.org from the published info@oemvp.org address; oemvp.eu also appears in circulation) and Сојуз на стопански комори (inferred chamber.mk from its official Facebook handle; the seeded 'sso.mk' returned nothing).

result.result_summary: Only business-registry profiles (zk.mk, companywall.com.mk) and social profiles were retrieved, not the organisations' own sites.

why_it_matters: Two significant pointer sources are recorded at low confidence and need a manual URL confirmation pass before scheduled collection.

description: No Albanian-language (sq) search terms were used in this pass, although the north-western chamber serves a largely Albanian-language business community and likely publishes in sq.

result.result_summary: Run scope specified mk and en only; sq association material therefore not searched.

why_it_matters: Positions of Albanian-language business associations on draft financial rules may be entirely missed.

description: mchamber.mk serves the same content under two hosts (mchamber.mk and mchamber.org.mk) and under both modern paths (/mk/home/propisi_info/ID) and legacy ASPX query strings with embedded ASP.NET session tokens (e.g. (S(skf2aj...))). fic.mk shows the same ASPX pattern.

result.result_summary: Observed in multiple search results; not tested for canonicalisation.

why_it_matters: Session-bearing URLs are unstable and will produce duplicate or dead records unless normalised at collection time.

description: Targeted enumeration for a Macedonian 'Banker'-style outlet at banker.mk and for profit.com.mk returned no results; the closest actual equivalents are bankarstvo.mk and pari.com.mk.

result.result_summary: No evidence found that banker.mk or profit.com.mk exist as active MK banking outlets; do not record them as sources.

why_it_matters: The cell brief names 'Bankarstvo/Banker-type outlets' — this pins the real domain (bankarstvo.mk) and prevents a fabricated banker.mk entry entering the registry.

description: Local-language searches on supervisory sanction terms (казна, супервизорска мерка) returned NBRM primary regulation and Wikipedia rather than press reporting of specific fines or measures against named banks.

result.result_summary: No press article documenting a concrete supervisory sanction was retrieved in this run.

why_it_matters: Either MK press rarely reports individual supervisory measures (a real intelligence limitation for A3), or the search index under-covers these outlets. Needs a dedicated enforcement-focused pass, ideally via time.mk site search.

description: Explicit site-scoped queries for fokus.mk and slobodenpecat.mk on banking-regulation terms returned no articles from those domains.

result.result_summary: Both outlets remain unverified for this topic; recorded with low confidence rather than dropped.

why_it_matters: A search-engine blind spot must not be mistaken for absence of coverage; a direct on-site search pass is required before ranking these outlets.

description: No feed endpoints (RSS/Atom) were confirmed for any outlet in this cell; suggested collection methods assume a feed exists but this was not tested.

result.result_summary: Feed availability unknown for all 17 candidates.

why_it_matters: Collection design (feed polling vs HTML crawl vs aggregator-mediated) hinges on this and should be resolved in the technical verification pass.
